Workflows.title: Start a Bank Simulator session, verify the account dashboard is usable, and review the checking account's read-only activity ledger
Workflows.goal: The welcome page loads and offers a GET STARTED NOW button to begin a session; The app navigates to the account dashboard and shows a one-time welcome dialog; The welcome dialog closes, revealing the account dashboard; The dashboard shows a Checking Account Activity widget and a Saving Account Activity widget, each with a visible available balance; The Account Activity page opens for the checking account and lists its transaction ledger; The ledger's most recent transaction row shows a Balance cell matching the available balance shown on the dashboard
Workflows.starting_hint:
1. Open the Bank Simulator welcome page — The welcome page loads and offers a GET STARTED NOW button to begin a session
2. Start a new simulator session — The app navigates to the account dashboard and shows a one-time welcome dialog
3. Dismiss the welcome dialog — The welcome dialog closes, revealing the account dashboard
4. Verify the dashboard is usable — The dashboard shows a Checking Account Activity widget and a Saving Account Activity widget, each with a visible available balance
5. Open the checking account's activity from the dashboard — The Account Activity page opens for the checking account and lists its transaction ledger
6. Confirm the checking ledger reflects the dashboard's available balance — The ledger's most recent transaction row shows a Balance cell matching the available balance shown on the dashboard
Workflows.test_name: starts a simulator session and reviews checking account activity
